paragraphs: I'm a Data & AI Engineer at the Kalyani Group in Pune, India, and a B.Tech IT graduate from VIT Pune (CGPA 8.68). I work across machine learning, backend and frontend, and I enjoy problems where the three meet: a model is only useful once it sits behind a clean API and an interface people want to use.
hackathon wins and podiums LeetCode Weekly Contest 428 LeetCode contest rating apps deployed live
features: Reads a chest X-ray, flags pneumonia, highlights the evidence with Grad-CAM heatmaps and writes a medical report.
An AI system that automates financial data extraction from PDF statements, replacing manual copy-and-paste.
Classifies bird species and detects signs of distress in animal sounds, using MobileNetV2 on spectrograms and MFCC features.
Decides where dark stores should go using demand clustering and Voronoi coverage maps. 2nd Runner-Up at Hackron'25 (Blinkit).
An interactive Git playground: stage, commit, branch and merge with a live commit graph, a simulated terminal, a visual merge-conflict resolver, private per-user sandboxes and Google/GitHub sign-in.
